page.overview:
Who is Ad'lestaa?

Ad'lestaa was a Human female engineer who crossed the Black Sun criminal organization on Coruscant during the time of the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, she was placed into a crate and set to be shipped off-world, but was rescued by a Republic-aligned individual.

Ad'lestaa is the subject of a hidden achievement called "Unusual Cargo" in the Dynamic Encounters on Coruscant in Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith, the eighth digital expansion to the massively multiplayer online role-playing game Star Wars: The Old Republic.
